<strong>Territoires.wiki est un site qui traite des territoires, de leurs habitants et de leurs histoires.</strong>

<p>Explorez, rencontrez, c'est à vous de jouer!</p>


<div class="w-grid">
    <div class="w-grid-box">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Actualités</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["News"],
                "extracts": true,
                "sort": "-Modification_date"
            }
        }'>
    </div>

    <div class="w-grid-box">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Événements</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["Events"],
                "extracts": true,
                "sort": "-Modification_date"
            }
        }'>
    </div>

    <div class="w-grid-box">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Territoires</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["Territories"],
                "extracts": true,
                "sort": "-Modification_date"
            }
        }'>
    </div>
</div>

<div data-widget="ContentMap" data-props='{
        "query": {
            "printouts":["coordinates=coordinates"],
            "sort": "-Modification_date",
            "filters": [
                ["coordinates", "exists"]
            ],
            "extracts": true
        },
        "autoloc": true,
        "full": true
    }'>
</div>

<div class="w-grid">
    <div class="w-grid-box">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Catégories</h2>
        {{#dpl:
            namespace=Category
            |mode=none
            |shownamespace=false
            |ordermethod=title
            |order=ascending
        }}
    </div>
</div>
